title: Phases 3-4: single validation season (2024), protocol v1
notes: Val MAE is on 2024. **Weighted** (by target-game dropbacks) is the official score; unweighted is logged alongside it to show whether a change helps across all games or mostly on high-dropback ones. **Win %** = share of 5,000 bootstrapped 2024 seasons (QBs drawn with replacement) where the change beats the previous best (`bootstrap_compare()` in src/models/evaluate.py); about 50% means a coin flip. **Keep rule** (DECISIONS.md): win % ≥ 80 AND weighted train MAE also better than the current best. Otherwise drop.

cells.change: Baseline: league average (train, weighted, +0.056) for every QB-game
cells.hypothesis: The floor: a rating that ignores who the QB is. Every model must beat it

cells.change: Baseline 2: QB season-to-date EPA/dropback (weeks < N, same season), league-average fallback in his first game
cells.hypothesis: Knowing who the QB is should beat one number for everyone
cells.keep/drop: drop (worse than league average, win 0.5%; keep as reference)

cells.change: Baseline 3: shrinkage, season-to-date blended with K=250 imaginary league-average dropbacks (K picked on train)
cells.hypothesis: Trusting a QB only as his dropbacks pile up beats both extremes

cells.change: Baseline 4: carry-over, shrinkage that starts each QB from his own shrunk previous season (K=300, picked on train)
cells.hypothesis: Week 1 had nothing to go on; last season should fix the early weeks
cells.keep/drop: keep (win 89.6% vs shrinkage; same small gain on train). Phase 3 bar to beat

cells.change: Phase 4 C1: linear regression on carry-over's raw ingredients (std_avg, std_dropbacks, last_avg, last_dropbacks), fit on train weighted by dropbacks
cells.hypothesis: Learned weights should beat hand-picked K=300
cells.keep/drop: keep as Phase 4 base (ties carry-over: win 54.5%, gain −0.006 to +0.006). Fixed weights can't trust std_avg more as dropbacks grow

cells.change: Phase 4 C2: linear regression on pre-shrunk averages (std_shrunk, last_shrunk, K=250)
cells.hypothesis: Shrunk features carry "trust grows with dropbacks", so one fixed weight should beat carry-over
cells.keep/drop: drop (worse than carry-over: win 5.0%; train also slightly worse, 0.2267 vs 0.2263). Last season's weight never fades as this season piles up

cells.change: Phase 4 C3: linear regression on carry-over split into two pieces (last_piece = last season shrunk x dimmer, this_piece = this season x (1 - dimmer), K=300)
cells.hypothesis: Learned weights on the handoff should edge out carry-over's fixed 1 and 1
cells.keep/drop: drop (win 13.1%; train slightly better 0.2261 vs 0.2263, val worse: fails both halves of the rule). Learned 0.83 / 1.03, intercept −0.015: no new information, just reweighting

cells.change: Phase 4 C4: + opponent defense strength (def_shrunk = EPA/dropback allowed in weeks < N, shrunk K=200 picked on train), linear on [carry_over, def_shrunk]
cells.hypothesis: First genuinely new information; defenses vary almost as much as QBs (season SD 0.09 vs 0.12)
cells.keep/drop: drop (win 20.4%; train better 0.2245 vs 0.2263 but val worse: fails the rule). Held out one train season at a time, defense helps in 6 of 8 (avg +0.0016); 2024 is one of the off years

title: Protocol v2: walk-forward (folds 2019-2024, trained on earlier seasons only), residual on carry-over
notes: Pooled MAE is dropback-weighted over all six folds. Win % = pooled bootstrap (QBs resampled) vs the current best at the time. Keep = win ≥ 80% AND better in ≥ 4 of 6 seasons. Reproduced in notebooks/03_features_ridge.ipynb.

cells.change: Carry-over (K re-picked per fold: 300 in all six)
Control (not a candidate): carry-over + constant shift only
C1: + raw features (std_avg, std_dropbacks, last_avg, last_dropbacks)
cells.keep/drop: **keep** (new best). Beats the constant-shift control in 6/6 seasons

cells.change: C2: + shrunk features (K per fold)
C3: + handoff pieces (K per fold)
C4: C1 + opponent defense (def_shrunk, K per fold: 100-300; weight 0.41-0.61)

title: Protocol v2 re-run with 2015 loaded as history only (supersedes the table above)

cells.change: Naive baseline: league average (re-computed per fold from earlier seasons: +.058 to +.066) for every QB-game
Control (not a candidate): constant shift only
C1: + raw features
C2: + shrunk features
C3: + handoff pieces
C4: C1 + opponent defense

C5: C4 + CPOE (cpoe_carry: carry-over recipe on CPOE, shrunk toward 0 by attempts; fold K (def, CPOE): (200,500) (100,800) (200,800) (200,1200) ×3). Hypothesis: accuracy stabilizes faster than EPA, so it helps most in weeks 1-4
cells.keep/drop: drop. CPOE weight negative in all six folds (−0.013 to −0.018 per CPOE point). Weeks 1-4 got *worse* (−.0006), 10+ slightly better (+.0004)

cells.change: C6: C4 + sack rate (sack_carry: carry-over recipe on sacks per dropback, shrunk toward the league rate of earlier seasons; fold K (def, sack): (300,50) (50,1200) (300,1200) (200,1200) ×3). Hypothesis: sack rate is QB-owned and stabilizes fast. Pre-check on 2016-2023: corr −0.48 with carry-over, +0.04 with C4's errors (CPOE: −0.01)
cells.keep/drop: **keep** (current best). Weight +2.3 to +2.6 in five folds (2019 fold: K=50, weight −0.09). Gain is largest in weeks 1-4 (+.0005), smallest in weeks 10+ (+.0001)

cells.change: C7: C6 + home (+1 home, −1 away, 0 neutral site; same K grid as C6). Hypothesis: home crowds hurt the visiting offense's passing. Pre-check on 2016-2023: corr 0.00 with C4's errors; raw EPA/dropback home +.056 vs away +.054
cells.keep/drop: drop. Home weight −0.0035 to +0.012 EPA/dropback across folds: no stable home edge in passing EPA

cells.change: Final Phase 4 model: Ridge on C6's features (scaled to SD 1; alpha picked per fold on season S−1 from 0.1-30000: 30000, 0.1, 0.1, 10000, 10000, 30000). Hypothesis: a penalty on big weights steadies six correlated features
cells.keep/drop: drop: ties plain linear except 2019, where 3 training seasons picked the biggest penalty. **Final Phase 4 model = C6, plain linear (pooled 0.2256)**

after: Floor check (at C4): the then-best (C4) beats the league average by 0.0108 pooled (win 100%, 6/6 seasons; per season +.0105 +.0166 +.0108 +.0083 +.0107 +.0082).

title: Phase 5: gradient boosting (same walk-forward protocol, same six features as C6)

cells.change: LightGBM on C6's features, residual on carry-over (lr 0.03, min 100 games per leaf, 80% subsample; (leaves, trees) picked per fold on season S−1 from {4,8,16}×{100,300,600}: (4,100) ×5, (8,100) in 2022). Hypothesis (Sid: tie): trees can learn interactions (defense matters mostly for veterans), but 4,000 noisy rows limit them
cells.keep/drop: drop (tie, as Sid predicted). Low-history QBs (last season ≤ 212 db): +.0010, win 83.9%; veterans −.0001, win 39.4%

cells.change: Reference only (hindsight, not a candidate): LightGBM with (4,100) fixed in every fold
cells.keep/drop: not eligible: the setting was chosen after seeing fold scores
